example_sentences_in_bangla: মানুষের শরীর খাঁচার মতো, আর অচিনপাখি তার প্রাণ।
অচিনপাখি চলে গেলে শরীর নিশ্চল হয়ে পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: The human body is like a cage, and the unknown bird is its life force.
When the unknown bird departs, the body becomes lifeless.
history: This idiom draws from the metaphorical idea of the soul or life force entering and exiting the body like an unknown bird in a cage, rooted in ancient Bengali philosophical expressions about the mystery of life.
note: The idiom often evokes the inexplicable nature of birth and death in Bengali culture.
